summary: Sister Lillian Murphy Community is a 152-unit affordable housing development at 671-691 China Basin St in Mission Bay, developed by Mercy Housing California and named for the Sisters of Mercy nun who founded Mercy Housing. San Francisco YIMBY reported the City and Mayor London Breed marking the completed building's dedication in April 2022.

milestones.text: City of San Francisco and Mayor London Breed held a dedication/celebration event for the completed housing development.

sources.title: Our City, Mayor London Breed Celebrate New Housing At 691 China Basin Street, Mission Bay, San Francisco

open_questions: The April 2022 event reported by SF YIMBY is a dedication/naming celebration, not necessarily the construction-completion or first-occupancy date; the article's own publication date (2022-04-05) is used as the approximate month since the event date itself is not stated.

Mercy Housing's own project page describes an application lottery conducted December 15, 2020, suggesting the building was substantially ready for leasing well before the April 2022 event -- but no source found in this pass gives an exact construction-completion or move-in date, so that earlier date is not used as the milestone.
